look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a login page card with a question mark, a page-vs-server check split, a route list with one open route, a central rule list wired to a server lock, and the kavach end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
